gaps.sentence: The plane made a hard but ___ (SUCCESS) landing.
They settled the dispute after a long ___ (ARGUE).
The bacteria are ___ (SEE) to the naked eye.
gaps.explanation: 'Invisible' = impossible to see — the negative adjective from VISIBLE/SEE.

gaps.sentence: He lost his ___ (CONFIDENT) after the failure.
The instructions were ___ (WRITE) in six languages.
gaps.explanation: Passive voice: were written — irregular participle of write.

gaps.sentence: The trainers were ___ (COMFORT) for long walks.
gaps.explanation: 'Were comfortable' — adjective; note the spelling: -able, not -ible.

gaps.sentence: We owe our success to her ___ (VISION) leadership.
She's a leading ___ (SCIENCE) in climate research.
